_note: MASSALIA's hireable people (content/people/pops.json) plus the philosopher, hetaira and priest, which are classes in MASSALIA and hires here. Upkeep is drachmae per season (MASSALIA charges per day; a MASSALIA day is a season). Food is wheat per hour at speed 1 in the capital, like troops.

people.name: Freeman
people.about: Shipwrights and craftsmen: the Harbor's work needs them.

people.name: Citizen
people.about: Votes, worships and fills the theatre.

people.name: Physician
people.about: Guards your household against poison, and cures it with a remedy.

people.name: Bodyguard
people.about: Stands between the head of your house and an assassin's knife.

people.name: Spymaster
people.about: Guards the house against plots, or hunts for openings in a rival's.

people.name: Priest
people.about: Serves your Sanctuary: the altar takes no offering without him, and its garden grows herbs while he tends it.

people.name: Philosopher
people.about: Tutors the head of your house: +10% hero experience, and study bears more fruit.

people.name: Hetaira
people.about: Keeps your Salon: she mixes its remedies and poisons, hears every secret (how many march against your towns), and opens the salon's own day.
